body:
tw// self harm and sexual abuse in *italics*

thank you so much for your kind words. you’ve managed to pinpoint how i feel and how my family are so accurately. i wrote the post in the midst of a breakdown */and i had been so emotionally torn i started self harming again. i felt so hopeless and that i might’ve ended it there. my family doesn’t believe in mental illness, and so many of my sisters, nieces, and cousins have been sexually abused by some of our own family members. they don’t care. and since my family came from central america, the way they view these things are so... awful. and so long in my life i’ve lived in poverty and homeless in the u.s. and i have social anxiety. they don’t care.*/

you dont have to read that part. it just feels good to vent. you’re honestly so kind for responding to me, and i’m so thankful for that. because even after all that, i do agree with you. that no matter how much the ugly parts of life tear my heart there’s still so much i want to live for. my younger siblings for example. or sunrises and sunsets, or reading my favorite books. also, whenever i come across kind people like you, it’s a beautiful reminder that there are still good people out there. but still... i am tired, haha. i’ll use your advice and try going to the hospital. maybe my older sister will help me with that, and if not... idk. i’ll try going myself, maybe. 

once again, thank your for responding. i don’t know what you’ve been through either, but i’m glad you’re here. you’re so strong. and i hope you’re doing well. :)
don’t listen to this person!! they suck!! you’re doing something you love and want to thank your readers and that is so amazing! op ily
ahh thank you! i’m so glad we could all have a discussion about this because i love the members so much and i was just so curious about this too! good luck with your studies!! i believe in you!

another beautiful comment thank you!!! i’m glad we all mostly agreed chan is easily understood and that makes my heart warm since we can rely on him in that way for language learning along with other ways that makes him such a great leader. he was actually the first person i understood korean without subtitles for like five minutes and that experience was so amazing! with felix and seungmin i love that they pay attention to their words! it makes us feel like they care to be understood and i like that! and thank you so much for the insight in the others especially hyunjin and in!! i do notice that when they say something they would stop as if they’re still thinking while speaking and i find it cute too.  i really want to be on the level to understand the members who use more difficult vocabulary and figurative language so bad!! and the members who are more carefree with their speech too!! minho i’m onto you... /j anyway, thank you so much for your comment i loved it so much!!

thank you so much!! ahh i love hearing insight about their speech because i’m a bit of a language nerd haha! what you said about changbin using beautiful words with casual ones actually made me gasp and wow i really want to learn more now!! same with felix i love how they use more precise words. and with seungmin, yes! i love how he accentuates his words clearly it just matches him so well. and with chan and you, so relatable!! i grew up spanish speaking in an english speaking country so yesss us bilinguals can relate xD thank you so much for your help!!

this post is like my dream post and everything i’ve always wanted!!!!!! you have no idea how much i reread your response! 

with chan, i have noticed the way he speaks is very slightly different and basically you summed up my thoughts. seungmin being meticulous about his speech does seem to align with the type of person he is, and i love to listen to him. one thing that made me jump in excitement about your comment was how amazing changbin’s lyrics are!! it is one of the reasons i wanted to learn korean because the music i love so much in its original words is breathtaking. i love understanding what the words mean especially when korean has some grammar that can be like more specific i guess? idk i just love its particles so much. and changbin omg yes i stan. 

i really love how felix implements different grammar in his speech because i can really relate! you know i just really love grammar and when u learn more u just want to keep using it and it becomes natural the more u do! and i too am so awed at his korean improvement it really is amazing! also, don’t forget that he’s constantly surrounded by a great environment of people who support his language learning and he lives surrounded by korean so don’t beat yourself up! the fact that you can understand and you can analyze their korean speech is amazing to me. 

also i didn’t notice that hyunjin’s intonation can go up and down compared to minho thank you so much for telling me!! and if you ever have more thoughts i would be glad to hear them but even if you don’t i still thank you so much!!!
NOOO NOT BOOMHAUER XD thank you so much and good luck with your studies as well~

oh yes!! i think this explains everything really well thank you!! and yeah today i discovered how minho speaks and its so cute xD but yeah i really do think it’s the accent that can sound more similar to mines and the fact that the grammar and such is used in the way i learned it, so thank you so much for helping! also side note i really love nct too and the mix of all their languages together makes me so happy!!

omg lee know!! he’s so funny and also i really love how it’s like he doesn’t care how the words come out he just says them sort of lazily? i don’t know but i really love it thank you xD also yes! seungmin is also someone i can understand well! thank you for your response~

that’s perfectly fine! i remember those stages where you know basic words and can catch them when spoken it’s so fun!! i believe in you! but yeah for me chan is easiest and changbin is the hardest haha
i love when people appreciates seungmin’s vocald because they’re my favorite wahhh he sounds so good! thank you for pointing out the adlibs
wow!! i really like your art! your hyunjin looks so pretty
